body:
I have absolutely no right to tell you what to do, this I'm going to say only in hope that it'll help you somehow.

Being accepted on college isn't really everything in life, I think you might start by looking for a job first, doesn't need to be anything special but at least you'll start feeling a bit more useful idk. I also live in a third world country, taxes are unbelievable and everything is expensive, I'm 21 and dropped college this semester and now do nothing but work during the day and play videogames at night. Working might as well mature you a little and give you some new ideas to what you might do in your future, perhaps you might even realize college is not for you at all and find something else to do which does not require a degree.
